description:

requirements.

title: Placement Officer
description:
Company: Proxima Skills Academy

Designation: Placement Officer

Department: Training & Placement

Experience: 2–3 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Location: Kolkata

Reporting To: Placement Manager / Management

**1. Job Overview**

Proxima Skills Academy is looking for a proactive, result-oriented and career-focused Placement Officer to manage student placement activities and develop strong relationships with corporate employers, recruitment agencies, CROs, pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, hospitals and healthcare organizations.

The candidate will be responsible for coordinating student placements, identifying job opportunities, sourcing relevant vacancies, building corporate relationships, preparing students for interviews and facilitating successful placement outcomes.

The ideal candidate should have good communication, networking, coordination and recruitment skills, with the ability to manage placement operations and achieve defined placement targets.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Corporate Relations & Employer Development**

* Identify and establish relationships with companies, CROs, pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, hospitals, healthcare institutions and clinical research organizations.
* Develop and maintain a database of corporate HR contacts, recruiters and hiring managers.
* Connect with HR professionals, Talent Acquisition teams and recruitment consultants to explore hiring opportunities.
* Develop new corporate partnerships for student placement opportunities.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with existing hiring partners to obtain active job requirements.
* Build long-term relationships with organizations for continuous placement opportunities.
* Explore recruitment opportunities across PAN India.

**B. Job Opportunities & Vacancy Management**

* Identify relevant job openings for students and trained candidates.
* Source vacancies through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, company career portals and recruitment networks.
* Collect and maintain updated Job Descriptions (JDs) from hiring organizations.
* Identify suitable candidates based on educational qualifications, skills, experience and job requirements.
* Share relevant candidate profiles with prospective employers.
* Maintain an updated database of active job openings, employer details and application status.
* Track interview schedules, selection updates, offer letters and joining status.

**C. Student Placement Coordination**

* Coordinate with students regarding placement eligibility, job preferences and career requirements.
* Maintain an updated database of placement-eligible students.
* Collect and verify student resumes, academic details and relevant documentation.
* Guide students in preparing professional resumes and optimizing their LinkedIn profiles.
* Conduct or coordinate mock interviews and interview preparation sessions.
* Share relevant job opportunities with eligible students.
* Prepare and forward shortlisted candidate profiles to hiring companies.
* Coordinate interview schedules between students and employers.
* Collect interview feedback and communicate selection or rejection updates.
* Follow up with selected candidates until successful joining.
* Collect joining confirmations and relevant placement proof.

**D. Recruitment & Interview Coordination**

* Understand employer requirements and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Screen student profiles against job specifications.
* Coordinate virtual and face-to-face interviews.
* Ensure candidates are adequately informed about interview schedules, job roles and employer expectations.
* Follow up with HR teams for interview feedback and selection decisions.
* Coordinate offer letter communication and joining formalities.
* Maintain records of candidate applications, interviews, selections and joining status.

**E. Placement Database & MIS Management**

* Maintain accurate student placement databases and employer databases.
* Track job opportunities, profiles shared, interview calls, selections and successful placements.
* Maintain company-wise and programme-wise placement reports.
* Update student placement status in the designated CRM or Google Sheets.
* Maintain records of employer communications, JDs, interview feedback and offer letters.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly placement performance reports.
* Ensure 100% accuracy and timely updating of placement-related information.

**F. Student Career Support & Coordination**

* Guide students regarding relevant job opportunities based on their qualifications and skills.
* Coordinate with trainers to understand students' technical competencies and job readiness.
* Identify skill gaps and communicate training requirements to the academic team.
* Support students in interview preparation, professional communication and career planning.
* Collect student feedback regarding placement services and interview experiences.
* Coordinate placement drives, recruitment events and employer interaction sessions.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Life Sciences or any relevant discipline.
* 2–3 years of experience in Placement Coordination, Recruitment, HR or Talent Acquisition.
* Experience in corporate relationship management and employer networking.
* Knowledge of recruitment portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn and Indeed.
* Good understanding of recruitment processes, job descriptions and candidate screening.
* Strong communication, negotiation and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and CRM platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple job requirements and candidate profiles simultaneously.
* Strong follow-up and relationship management skills.
* Target-oriented and result-driven approach.

title: HR Business Partner – Talent Acquisition
description:
**About LoglineAI**

LoglineAI is an AI-powered creative studio helping content studios, brands, and agencies go from pitch to fully packaged content — faster, smarter, and leaner. Part of the SVF ecosystem alongside hoichoi (India's leading Regional OTT platform) and Sooper (AI-led micro-drama OTT)

**The Opportunity**

LoglineAI is growing, and every new hire shapes how the studio works. In this role, you will own hiring from start to finish across creative, tech and client-facing teams — this is about 80% of the job. The other 20% is core people operations: onboarding, documentation, employee queries and exits.

You will work closely with founders and hiring managers, and you will be the person who makes sure we hire the right people, quickly and fairly.

**What you'll do**

* Own end-to-end hiring for creative, tech and client-facing roles, closing each role within an agreed time-to-hire target.
* Build a strong pipeline for every open role through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, creative communities and direct outreach, so each role has a qualified shortlist within the first week.
* Run a clear intake with every hiring manager before sourcing starts — agree on must-haves, outcomes and the interview plan, so fewer roles need to be re-opened.
* Run structured interviews — screens, scorecards, panel scheduling and debriefs — so every hiring decision is backed by clear evidence.
* Track and share hiring metrics every week (time-to-hire, offer acceptance rate, source quality, pipeline health) and use them to fix slow stages.
* Manage offers and pre-joining, keeping candidates engaged until Day 1 to keep offer drop-offs low.
* Make sure every new joiner has access, tools, a buddy and a 90-day plan in their first week.
* Handle core people operations — employee records, letters, policy queries and exits — accurately and on time.
* Be the go-to partner for managers and team members on everyday people matters, raising issues early before they grow.
* Use AI tools to speed up sourcing, screening and documentation, cutting time spent on repeat task.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* A track record of owning hiring for several roles at once, with numbers to show it — roles closed, time-to-hire, offer acceptance.
* Strong sourcing skills: you can find and engage passive candidates, not just post jobs and wait.
* Experience running structured interviews and working closely with hiring managers.
* Working knowledge of core HR operations — onboarding, employee documentation, lifecycle letters and exits.
* Clear, warm communication with candidates, managers and leadership.
* Uses AI tools to summarise data, draft documents, and explore process improvements — and knows how to verify and correct AI outputs.

**Good to Have**

* Experience hiring for creative roles (writers, designers, editors, producers) or AI/tech roles.
* Hands-on use of an ATS or async screening tools
* Basic understanding of Indian labour law and HR compliance.
* Experience building employer brand content for a young company.

**Culture & How We Work**

At LoglineAI, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross-functional teams where content, product, growth, and tech sit close together, argue productively, and occasionally steal each other's snacks. It's a lot like a kitchen during a house party: slightly chaotic, everyone's doing three things at once, but somehow the food comes out great.

Ownership here isn't a buzzword; it's the default setting. If something's broken, you don't file a ticket and wait. You're the person who notices the printer is jammed and just fixes it instead of pretending you didn't see it. We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Think less 'perfect deck' and more 'let's see if real viewers actually care.'

When big moments arrive, we stretch. But we're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable, because burnt-out teams build neither great products nor great stories. If that sounds like your kind of chaos, we should talk.

**The Opportunity**

LoglineAI is growing, and every new hire shapes how the studio works. In this role, you will own hiring from start to finish across creative, tech and client-facing teams — this is about 80% of the job. The other 20% is core people operations: onboarding, documentation, employee queries and exits.

You will work closely with founders and hiring managers, and you will be the person who makes sure we hire the right people, quickly and fairly.

**What you'll do**

* Own end-to-end hiring for creative, tech and client-facing roles, closing each role within an agreed time-to-hire target.
* Build a strong pipeline for every open role through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, creative communities and direct outreach, so each role has a qualified shortlist within the first week.
* Run a clear intake with every hiring manager before sourcing starts — agree on must-haves, outcomes and the interview plan, so fewer roles need to be re-opened.
* Run structured interviews — screens, scorecards, panel scheduling and debriefs — so every hiring decision is backed by clear evidence.
* Track and share hiring metrics every week (time-to-hire, offer acceptance rate, source quality, pipeline health) and use them to fix slow stages.
* Manage offers and pre-joining, keeping candidates engaged until Day 1 to keep offer drop-offs low.
* Make sure every new joiner has access, tools, a buddy and a 90-day plan in their first week.
* Handle core people operations — employee records, letters, policy queries and exits — accurately and on time.
* Be the go-to partner for managers and team members on everyday people matters, raising issues early before they grow.
* Use AI tools to speed up sourcing, screening and documentation, cutting time spent on repeat task.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* A track record of owning hiring for several roles at once, with numbers to show it — roles closed, time-to-hire, offer acceptance.
* Strong sourcing skills: you can find and engage passive candidates, not just post jobs and wait.
* Experience running structured interviews and working closely with hiring managers.
* Working knowledge of core HR operations — onboarding, employee documentation, lifecycle letters and exits.
* Clear, warm communication with candidates, managers and leadership.

* Basic understanding of Indian labour law and HR compliance.
* Experience building employer brand content for a young company.

**Culture & How We Work**

At LoglineAI, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross-functional teams where content, product, growth, and tech sit close together, argue productively, and occasionally steal each other's snacks. It's a lot like a kitchen during a house party: slightly chaotic, everyone's doing three things at once, but somehow the food comes out great.

Ownership here isn't a buzzword; it's the default setting. If something's broken, you don't file a ticket and wait. You're the person who notices the printer is jammed and just fixes it instead of pretending you didn't see it. We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Think less 'perfect deck' and more 'let's see if real viewers actually care.'

When big moments arrive, we stretch. But we're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable, because burnt-out teams build neither great products nor great stories. If that sounds like your kind of chaos, we should talk.

 **Talent Acquisition Specialist**

 **target\-oriented, highly organised, proactive, and comfortable with volume hiring**

 for customer acquisition, international telesales, customer service and other operational roles.

* Good working knowledge of

**1\. Training \& Student Development** 



* Coordinate and support training programs designed to improve students' employability and industry readiness.
* Organize aptitude training, soft\-skills training, communication skills, interview preparation, group discussions, and other career development programs.
* Coordinate workshops, seminars, guest lectures, industry sessions, career counselling programs, and pre\-placement talks.

**2\. Placement \& Recruitment Coordination** 



* Coordinate campus recruitment drives from initial communication with recruiters through completion of the recruitment process.
* Assist in identifying and inviting companies for campus placement and internship opportunities.
* Coordinate student registration, eligibility verification, shortlisting, and communication with candidates.
* Schedule aptitude tests, group discussions, technical rounds, HR interviews, and other recruitment activities.
* Ensure timely communication of recruitment schedules, instructions, and requirements to students and concerned departments.
* Support recruiters during campus visits and ensure smooth execution of placement activities.



**3\. Corporate \& Employer Relations** 



* Develop and maintain professional relationships with HR professionals, recruiters, corporate organizations, and industry representatives.
* Assist in identifying new companies and industry partners for placements, internships, training, and institutional collaborations.
* Maintain an updated database of recruiters, corporate contacts, placement partners, and industry organizations.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with recruiters regarding placement opportunities and recruitment requirements.
* Assist in coordinating corporate meetings, industry visits, MoUs, and other institutional\-industry engagement activities.



**4\. Internship Coordination** 



* Coordinate internship opportunities for students with suitable organizations.
* Communicate internship requirements and opportunities to students and academic departments.
* Assist in collecting and maintaining internship\-related documents and records.
* Track student internship status, joining, completion, and feedback.
* Maintain an updated internship database and submit periodic reports to the concerned authority.



**5\. Student Coordination \& Support** 



* Guide students regarding placement registration, eligibility criteria, recruitment procedures, interview schedules, and required documentation.
* Maintain regular communication with students regarding placement and training activities.
* Assist students in preparing resumes/CVs and other placement\-related documents.
* Coordinate student participation in off\-campus and on\-campus recruitment activities.
* Address routine student queries related to training, internships, and placements and escalate matters where required.



**6\. MIS, Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate records of student profiles, placement status, internship details, recruiter information, and training activities.
* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and event\-wise reports as required by the Management.
* Maintain placement and training MIS in Excel/Google Sheets or other institutional systems.
* Track placement targets, recruitment drives, student participation, selections, offers, internships, and joining status.
* Ensure proper documentation of all Training \& Placement activities.

* Ensure participation of students from different departments in relevant training and placement initiatives.

* Coordinate venue, seating, registration, student attendance, recruiter requirements, and other logistical arrangements.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination among recruiters, students, faculty members, and administrative teams.



**9\. External Visits \& Field Coordination** 



* Visit corporate offices, companies, training organizations, and industry partners as required.
* Assist in corporate meetings, business development activities, industry visits, and placement\-related institutional collaborations.
* Willingness to travel within and outside Kolkata/West Bengal for placement and corporate relations activities, as required.



**10\. Additional Responsibilities** 



* Support the Senior Training \& Placement Officer / Head of the Department in achieving institutional placement and training objectives.
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Management from time to time in connection with Training \& Placement, Corporate Relations, Student Development, or Institutional Activities.



**Eligibility \& Qualification** 




**Essential Qualification** 



* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized university/institution.
* Minimum
 **6\-7 years of relevant experience** 
 in Training \& Placement, Corporate Relations,



**Preferred Qualification** 



* Master's Degree in Management, HR, Business Administration, Education, or a relevant discipline.
* Prior experience in an educational institution, university, college, training organization will be preferred.



**Essential Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills.
* Good presentation and negotiation abilities.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly
 **Excel, Word, and PowerPoint** 
 .
* Ability to maintain MIS, databases, reports, and official documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with students, faculty members, management, and corporate representatives.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple activities simultaneously.
* Willingness to travel for corporate meetings, recruitment drives, industry visits, and institutional activities.



  





**Personal Attributes**

* Proactive and target\-oriented.
* Confident and professional in communication.
* Well\-organized and disciplined.
* Comfortable interacting with students, faculty, management, and corporate professionals.
* Capable of working independently as well as part of a team.
* Flexible to handle multiple responsibilities and institutional requirements.

* Opportunity to work with a growing and diverse educational institution.
